609353364333.title: Rose hydrosol
609353364333.description:
Natural rose hydrosol obtained by steam distillation of freshly picked petals. The roses are hand-picked in the ecologically clean mountain regions of Adjara, where the mild climate, clean air and fertile soil help the plants accumulate the maximum of natural active substances.

The hydrosol gently moisturizes the skin, soothes redness, helps maintain the natural pH and gives a feeling of freshness. Suitable for all skin types, especially dry, sensitive, mature and irritation-prone skin.

Properties:
  • intensely moisturizes and refreshes the skin;
  • soothes redness and discomfort;
  • helps maintain skin firmness and elasticity;
  • improves the complexion;
  • works as a toner, a refreshing mist and for mixing dry masks.

How to use: spray the hydrosol onto cleansed skin of the face, neck and décolleté or apply with a cotton pad. Use morning, evening or during the day for extra hydration and freshness.

Ingredients (INCI): Rosa Damascena Flower Water.

No alcohol, fragrances or preservatives. Only pure hydrosol with the delicate natural scent of fresh roses.
